title: Northgate Protect Plan Price Schedule
content:
Every Northgate Protect plan sold on a single item has a one-time price fixed by the price band that contains the covered item's price, where the item price is the net price paid for the item before tax. The Northgate Protect Complete Monthly subscription has no price bands and is paid by a monthly fee instead.

## How each tier is paid

| Tier | Billing cycle | Monthly fee |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Protect Standard 2-Year | One time, at purchase | Not applicable |
| Northgate Protect Standard 3-Year | One time, at purchase | Not applicable |
| Northgate Protect Accident 2-Year | One time, at purchase | Not applicable |
| Northgate Protect Accident 3-Year | One time, at purchase | Not applicable |
| Northgate Protect Accident 4-Year | One time, at purchase | Not applicable |
| Northgate Protect Complete Monthly | Monthly | $16.99 |

## One-time plan prices by covered item price band

| Net item price before tax | Standard 2-Year | Standard 3-Year | Accident 2-Year | Accident 3-Year | Accident 4-Year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $20.00 to $49.99 | $4.00 | $6.00 | not offered | not offered | not offered |
| $50.00 to $99.99 | $8.00 | $11.00 | $13.00 | $17.00 | $21.00 |
| $100.00 to $149.99 | $12.00 | $17.00 | $20.00 | $26.00 | $32.00 |
| $150.00 to $199.99 | $17.00 | $24.00 | $27.00 | $36.00 | $44.00 |
| $200.00 to $299.99 | $25.00 | $35.00 | $39.00 | $52.00 | $64.00 |
| $300.00 to $399.99 | $33.00 | $46.00 | $54.00 | $72.00 | $88.00 |
| $400.00 to $499.99 | $42.00 | $59.00 | $69.00 | $89.00 | $109.00 |
| $500.00 to $749.99 | $59.00 | $82.00 | $94.00 | $124.00 | $149.00 |
| $750.00 to $999.99 | $79.00 | $109.00 | $129.00 | $169.00 | $209.00 |
| $1,000.00 to $1,499.99 | $109.00 | $149.00 | $179.00 | $229.00 | $279.00 |
| $1,500.00 to $1,999.99 | $149.00 | $199.00 | $239.00 | $309.00 | $379.00 |
| $2,000.00 to $2,999.99 | $199.00 | $269.00 | $319.00 | $409.00 | $499.00 |
| $3,000.00 to $5,000.00 | $279.00 | $379.00 | $449.00 | $579.00 | $699.00 |

Price bands do not apply to Northgate Protect Complete Monthly. The Accident tiers have no band below $50.00.

## Reading the schedule

- The band is chosen by the net price paid for the covered item before tax, and both ends of a band belong to it: an item at exactly $500.00 falls in the $500.00 to $749.99 band, and an item at $499.99 in the band below.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* an item bought for a net $812.40 before tax sits in the $750.00 to $999.99 band, so its plan price is $79.00 on Standard 2-Year, $109.00 on Standard 3-Year, $129.00 on Accident 2-Year, $169.00 on Accident 3-Year and $209.00 on Accident 4-Year.
- A one-time price is charged once at purchase; Complete Monthly is charged its monthly fee each month.
